suppliedNarration.speaker: 余荫铠
suppliedNarration.processing: Used once as one continuous take. The exact MP3 is preserved for delivery; the working WAV is decoded to 48 kHz stereo and receives only frame-aligned tail silence.

curatedMusic.sources: Eleven audited public artist, label, ensemble or official-video sources: a classical spine plus complete HOYO-MiX chapter identities for Cylinder and Sphere; authorship, performers, source pages, audio-quality limits and exact hashes are recorded per item in music-plan.json
curatedMusic.editing: Source-native tempo, chapter-specific excerpts, once-per-source-span normalization, integer-sample placement, exact 84-frame qsin adjacent crossfades, title-vacuum automation and narration ducking; Saint-Saëns organ scale is reserved for the final 16.9-second challenge cadence
curatedMusic.referenceUsage: Chapter contrast, title punctuation, large-scale dynamic contour and narration-space study only; the reference recording is not included as a full-range source in the final mix

legacyOriginalScore.sourceRevisionSubject: fix: rewrite footsteps return score and evidence

legacyOriginalScore.editableSources: Eleven MusicXML parts plus orchestration and timeline mapping metadata
legacyOriginalScore.rendering: MuseScore 4 with MuseScore Basic, resampled to 48 kHz stereo and mapped at structural anchors to the integer-frame chapter timeline

generatedAudio.voice: User-supplied final narration by 余荫铠; original MP3 preserved byte-for-byte in the delivery package
generatedAudio.score: Eleven curated excerpts built on Satie, Ravel, Bach, Scriabin, Debussy and Saint-Saëns, with two complete HOYO-MiX chapter voices; the organ finale is confined to the final 16.9 seconds, and no original-score bus or full-range Footprints reference cue is used
generatedAudio.soundEffects: Original deterministic synthesis generated by this repository from card, seam, five-stone, 2D-to-3D and finale events
